notes: Cyder010-dxvk2 is Cyder009-dxmt plus CompatDB ntdll that accepts graphics_backend dxvk2 (MoltenVK path shared with dxvk). Same teardown / frame-walk / A6 / MoltenVK wait-poll shim / QDO optnone bandage / shipped lib/dxmt as Cyder009-dxmt. DXMT host winemetal.so may declare minos up to 15.0 (pack gate exemption); Cyder only offers DXMT on macOS 15+. Graphics payloads (lib/dxvk, lib/dxvk2, lib/dxmt) are excluded from the engine tarball and shipped separately.
